kit.cover_letter:
Dear Hiring Team,

I am writing to express my interest in the Software Engineer Intern role at Nutrithy Wellness. As an MCA student at PES University with practical full-stack development experience, I am eager to contribute to your software development initiatives.

During my internship at Sunflower Trip, I built a production-ready tours and travel management system using Angular, Node.js, Express, and MySQL, which went live for real customer bookings. Additionally, I delivered a full Point of Sale system for a freelance client utilizing Angular, C#, and MS SQL Server deployed on Azure. 

My personal projects further demonstrate my technical capabilities. For instance, I developed Zenvest, a MERN stack trading platform featuring JWT authentication and third-party market data API integration. I also built StaySphere, an Airbnb-style rental platform incorporating Node.js, Express, MongoDB, and Passport.js authentication.

I am comfortable working with JavaScript-based software development, building features, improving existing code, and integrating APIs. I look forward to the possibility of discussing how my background aligns with your team's needs.

Sincerely,
Amaanuddin Ahmed
